suggestions: The game is excellent — well-paced, clear objectives, meaningful choices with consequences
Crown path (social/Envoy route) feels faster and more rewarding than verse hunting would be
The reeve/priest disagreement on sealing creates nice roleplay tension — resolving it via silence is elegant
Lore delivery through found items (seal's writing, crown's engraving, verses) is masterful
The 'kneeling trap' is well-telegraphed early; game communicates what matters
